title: Ruslan and Lyudmila
overview: The young knight Ruslan stands up for Lyudmila and spoils the plans of her father, Prince Vladimir, to marry her daughter to one of the worthy fellows – Ragday, Ratmir or Farlaf. Lyudmila falls in love with Ruslan, he is also fascinated by the beauty, but their happiness will not happen: Vladimir is against it, and then Lyudmila is completely kidnapped by the envious sorcerer Chernomor, eager to avenge the prince for past insults.

title: The Frog Princess 3
overview: Continuation of the franchise "The Frog Princess".

title: Incredible Tatyana Viktorovna
overview: Tatyana Viktorovna Gizatullina is an English teacher from the city of Bugulma, where everything seems to be forever stuck between the past and the future. After a series of failures, she desperately turns to space with a request for a miracle - and suddenly the news spreads around the city: the first Bugulma cosmonaut Sergey Lysov, her classmate, is returning home after 25 years. This event sets off a chain of incredible changes in the life of Tatyana and the entire school.

title: Red Ghost 1812
overview: The estate of young Count Mikhail Razumovskiy is mercilessly plundered by French foragers. And the young man is saved from death by the Ghost, a lone partisan returning home and protecting civilians from marauders along the way. Dreaming of revenge, Mikhail sets off with the Ghost. He will have to learn the difference between heroism and duty from his own experience, become the Ghost's student, and then independently end his fight, preventing a French counterattack and saving many lives on both sides.

title: Мой немолодой человек
overview: Successful architect Zhenya has long known how life works. Student Yulia is confident she'll figure it all out. They meet by chance and fall in love at the most inopportune moment. Inopportune because the age difference between them is too large. But is there such a thing as inopportune love? While friends argue, parents worry, a psychologist tries to figure things out, and casual acquaintances eagerly offer unsolicited advice, the couple must decide whether love is worth the sacrifice of other people's opinions.

title: Враг
overview: Severely wounded fighters stranded in the "gray zone" must contend with hunger, fend off drones, and engage in lopsided combat—all while struggling to survive and figure out who the real enemy is.

title: Tulpa
overview: An outcast girl falls in love with Louis, the most handsome boy in the school, but is unable to get to know him due to her indecisiveness. She creates a tulpa, a copy of Louis, who is passionately in love with her. But what if the real Louis fall in love with her and the copy feels violated and abandoned? While Camille herself could turn out to be someone else's tulpa, created to solve a terrible mystery from the past.

title: Kostomarov: Stronger Than Fate
overview: From the hardships of youth to Olympic gold in Turin, Roman Kostomarov has come a long way to dance his legendary "Carmen." His wife, Oksana, has been by his side all these years, becoming his main support on the ice and in life. But fate had a test in store for the athlete: after a series of ice shows, he was admitted to intensive care with a severe complication. Doctors inform Oksana that they were forced to put him into a coma. A desperate battle for his life begins among doctors, family, and friends.

title: Varvara the Beauty
overview: A simple blacksmith, Andrey, finds himself in the underwater kingdom in the place of the prince. There, unexpectedly, he wins the heart of the beautiful Varvara and becomes involved in events that could change the fate of two worlds.

title: Я призрак
overview: Pasha «Veterok» is a brilliant con man who created a Ponzi scheme that has lured gullible citizens, businessmen, and criminal kingpins alike. As Veterok prepares to disappear with the money to Bali, his plans are thwarted-someone is already aiming a sniper rifle at him. Young detective Lyosha Boldyrev is assigned to investigate this mysterious murder. Oddly enough, Veterok himself is among the victims of his scheme: Lyosha invested his last money in the scheme to treat his ailing grandmother. While Lyosha is still processing what's happening, Pasha's ghost appears before him. Returning from heaven, the con man must atone for his guilt before those he deceived. Now, Pasha, having acquired "ghostly" superpowers, helps Lyosha investigate his own murder, while the detective gradually immerses himself in the dangerous world of his former clients. Will the con man ever be forgiven? And how do you do that if you're a ghost and your partner is a principled cop?

title: Три поросёнка
overview: Three spoiled brothers—whom their parents, not without reason, liken to the Three Little Pigs—head off to the countryside to visit their grandfather. While searching for a legendary, wish-granting fern flower, they accidentally set free an ancient sorcerer named Volkolak and find themselves transformed into piglets. As the villain rushes to complete an age-old magical ritual that will render him all-powerful, the brothers have just one night to stop him and regain their human forms. To succeed, they must—for the first time—put aside their squabbles, learn to trust one another, and become a true team.

title: Day Drinker
overview: A private-yacht bartender encounters a mysterious, onboard guest. They soon find themselves entangled with a criminal figure and connected in ways no one saw coming.

title: Noise of Time
overview: About one of the most famous composers of the 20th century, Dmitriy Dmitrievich Shostakovich.

title: Winnie-the-Pooh and All-All-All
overview: Twelve-year-old Artyom discovers a portal to the magical Enchanted Forest at an abandoned dacha and meets its amazing inhabitants, Winnie the Pooh and his friends. But an attempt to show off his find to his peers turns into a disaster - Artyom is laughed at, because most people see ordinary toys rather than fairy-tale characters. The magic portal disappears, leaving Pooh and his friends in the human world. 20 years later, Artyom, who has forbidden himself to dream and has sunk into routine, finds Winnie the Pooh again, and with him a chance to return the lost meaning to his life. But to do this, they all have to find Piglet, Rabbit and Owl, scattered across different corners of the country, and send them all back to their native Enchanted Forest.

title: Little Brownie Kuzya 3
overview: Kuzya learns about a magical Flower that can make your deepest wish come true, and decides to use it to become human. But Kikimora, Baba Yaga’s sister, who has been dreaming of taking her place for many years, is also hunting for the miraculous power. As her plan begins to come true, Kuza must embark on a real fairy-tale adventure and discover that being yourself is much more important than becoming someone else.

title: Бисура
overview: Ural, a young entrepreneur, returns from the big city to his native Bashkir countryside with plans to build a factory. However, his plans fall apart when he encounters a mythical forest spirit. To save himself and his friends, Ural must undergo a mystical trial—one in which both the fate of his village and his own soul are at stake.
